_comments.authoritative: False means these values are demonstration fixtures, not live station telemetry.
_comments.lastUpdated: UTC timestamp for the fixture snapshot.

_comments.kp: Planetary K-index from 0 to 9; higher values indicate stronger geomagnetic activity.
_comments.temperature: Station air temperature in degrees Celsius.
_comments.pbl: Planetary boundary-layer height in metres; useful for atmospheric propagation context.
_comments.winterOverDay: Current day number in the winter-over deployment.
_comments.orbits: Satellite passes considered visible and usable during the current day.
_comments.dataCapturedTb: Payload data captured in the previous 24 hours, measured in terabytes.
_comments.linkAvailability: Percentage of the communications link available during the reporting period.

passes._comments: Satellite capture opportunity. Elevation is peak degrees above the horizon; azimuth is degrees clockwise from north; duration is minutes.

_comments.forecast: Kp values at successive three-hour forecast points, ordered from oldest to newest.
_comments.alerts: Operator-facing communication guidance generated from the storm forecast.
